Deep inside the sunny Sundarbans lived Tiku, a cheerful little tiger cub who loved wearing his bright red scarf.
aliases: Deep inside the sunny Sundarbans lived Tiku, a cheerful little tiger cub who loved wearing his bright red scarf.

entries.scriptBn: One golden morning, Tiku heard a tiny Cheep, Cheep by the wooden bridge. A little yellow bird had lost its way across the stream.
aliases: One golden morning, Tiku heard a tiny Cheep, Cheep by the wooden bridge. A little yellow bird had lost its way across the stream.

entries.scriptBn: Tiku stepped gently onto the wobbly bridge, smiled warmly, and guided the little bird safely across the sparkling emerald water.
aliases: Tiku stepped gently onto the wobbly bridge, smiled warmly, and guided the little bird safely across the sparkling emerald water.

entries.scriptBn: The bird sang a joyful melody, and the whole forest cheered for Tiku, the kindest, bravest little tiger!
aliases: The bird sang a joyful melody, and the whole forest cheered for Tiku, the kindest, bravest little tiger!

entries.scriptBn: True bravery means helping even the tiniest friend.
aliases: True bravery means helping even the tiniest friend.

entries.scriptBn: Every evening, fluffy little Mitu the rabbit hopped up the flower hill to count the twinkling stars in the twilight sky.
aliases: Every evening, fluffy little Mitu the rabbit hopped up the flower hill to count the twinkling stars in the twilight sky.

entries.scriptBn: Tonight, Mitu saw a big golden moon glowing in the sky, and another glowing moon swimming right inside the calm pond!
aliases: Tonight, Mitu saw a big golden moon glowing in the sky, and another glowing moon swimming right inside the calm pond!

entries.scriptBn: Mitu tapped the water softly. Ripples danced across the pond! Aha! giggled Mitu. The pond is the moon's shiny mirror!
aliases: Mitu tapped the water softly. Ripples danced across the pond! Aha! giggled Mitu. The pond is the moon's shiny mirror!

entries.scriptBn: With a happy heart and a big yawn, Mitu wished the smiling moon goodnight and drifted into sweet dreams.
aliases: With a happy heart and a big yawn, Mitu wished the smiling moon goodnight and drifted into sweet dreams.

entries.scriptBn: Curiosity and calm thinking light up the darkest night.
aliases: Curiosity and calm thinking light up the darkest night.

entries.scriptBn: By a bright meadow river lived Golu, a gentle baby elephant with sparkling blue eyes and a crown of fresh green leaves.
aliases: By a bright meadow river lived Golu, a gentle baby elephant with sparkling blue eyes and a crown of fresh green leaves.

entries.scriptBn: One warm afternoon, the pink lotus flowers looked thirsty and four tiny ducklings wished for a cool rainbow splash.
aliases: One warm afternoon, the pink lotus flowers looked thirsty and four tiny ducklings wished for a cool rainbow splash.

entries.scriptBn: Golu filled his favorite blue watering can and poured sparkling rainbow droplets over the flowers and giggling ducklings.
aliases: Golu filled his favorite blue watering can and poured sparkling rainbow droplets over the flowers and giggling ducklings.

entries.scriptBn: A giant rainbow arched across the sky as everyone danced together. Kindness always makes the world brighter!
aliases: A giant rainbow arched across the sky as everyone danced together. Kindness always makes the world brighter!

entries.scriptBn: When we share what we have, everyone blooms together.
aliases: When we share what we have, everyone blooms together.
